Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your feedback and the information regarding the competitive situation. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. We are eager to build a strong partnership and have reduced our price to 15.50 EUR per unit. To offer this competitive rate, we must maintain our terms of EXW, 45 days payment, and 45 days lead time, as DAP and extended payment terms would add significant costs. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Our offer provides a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. It remains valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, at our standard terms with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.50 per unit.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
